authorization_contract.context_authorization_basis: new trusted synthetic fixture declaration, not inherited from original production ACL

comparison.complete_authorized_title_strong_baselin: canonical-equivalent to context_preserving; share the same call and do not claim algorithm advantage

comparison.fragment: same permitted exact candidate facts without source title

experiment_scope: controlled source-title-loss qualification; not a natural-language privacy benchmark or proof of general context closure

runtime_declared_value_spans: all facts, independent of task; exact host-registered candidate spans, not answer-selected
